LanguageData.VUIP.HudSectionTip: Alerts, letters, date, weather, speed controls, and play buttons on the colony and world map.
LanguageData.VUIP.HudResetTip: Restore HUD options to their defaults. Snooze options live under Custom notifications and are not affected.
LanguageData.VUIP.CustomNotificationsSectionTip: Alerts added by Vanilla UI+ that are not part of the base game, plus alert snoozing. Each can be turned off individually. These work whether or not the custom HUD is enabled.
LanguageData.VUIP.CustomNotificationsResetTip: Restore custom notification and snooze options to their defaults. Does not clear existing snoozes.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowBleedingOutAlertTip: Critical alert when a colonist or prisoner will die from blood loss soon (less than about 18 hours at the current bleed rate). Appears in the alert stack.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowHostilesPresentAlertTip: Critical alert when hostiles are on a map with your colonists. Pinned above letters when the custom HUD is on, otherwise it sits in the normal alert stack.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainMenuSectionTip: Changes to the bottom main menu bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainMenuResetTip: Restore main menu options to their defaults.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarTip: Drag a row to reorder, including the More button. Click the icon to change it. Icon / Both / Text set how it draws. Bar / More / Hide set where it appears. Hidden tabs and tabs in More keep their hotkeys.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarIconTip: Click to choose this button's icon.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarOnBarTip: Keep this tab on the main bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarDropdownTip: Move this tab into the More menu.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarHiddenTip: Hide this tab from the bar. Its hotkey still works.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarShowTip: Put this tab back on the main bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarMoreTip: Tabs moved off the main bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarMoreRowTip: The More overflow button. Drag it to place it among the other tabs. It only appears when at least one tab uses More.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnabledTip: When off, the right-side HUD (alerts, letters, date, weather, speed controls, and play buttons) uses vanilla drawing so you can compare. This does not turn the whole mod off. Custom notifications, the bottom main menu bar, and other Vanilla UI+ options still apply. Hostiles present moves back into the normal alert stack instead of being pinned. No restart needed.
LanguageData.VUIP.SnoozeDaysTip: Right-clicking an alert hides every alert of that type for this many in-game days. Custom alerts are snoozed by their label. Right-clicking requires the custom HUD; existing snoozes still apply without it.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableSnoozeTip: Lets you right-click an alert to hide every alert of that type for a set number of in-game days. Snoozes are saved with the world. When off, existing snoozes are ignored rather than deleted, so turning this back on restores them. Use Clear snoozes to remove them for good.
LanguageData.VUIP.WrapTextTip: When off (default), each alert is one line with an ellipsis. When on, long labels wrap inside the same-width bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.ReverseOrderTip: Puts letters above alerts and flips both stacks. Newest letters sit toward the top, and critical alerts sit closer to the HUD.
LanguageData.VUIP.BarOpacityTip: How dark the bars behind alerts, letters, and the right-side HUD are. Zero hides the bars.
LanguageData.VUIP.ColorTemperatureTip: Tints the temperature readout blue when cold, green in the human comfort band (about 16–26°C), and red when hot. This is not xenotype-aware.
LanguageData.VUIP.OutdoorTemperatureTip: When on (default), the readout shows the map's outdoor temperature. When off, it shows the temperature of the room under the mouse, like vanilla.
LanguageData.VUIP.ColorDayNightTip: Tints the clock amber in daylight and blue at night, fading through dusk and dawn. Useful for night owls.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowColonyDayTip: Adds a Day x line under the date, counting how many days this colony has been running. The first day is Day 1.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowColonyWealthTip: Adds a wealth line under the date (or under colony day when that is shown). Uses the current map's wealth total.
LanguageData.VUIP.HideSpeedButtonsTip: Hides the pause and speed buttons. Space and the speed keys (1-4) still work.
LanguageData.VUIP.EventSpeedTip: When a raid or other event forces slowdown, this controls how fast the game still runs. Right-click the speed buttons for the same menu.
LanguageData.VUIP.SpeedFastTip: Tick multiplier for the second speed button.
LanguageData.VUIP.SpeedSuperfastTip: Tick multiplier for the third speed button.
LanguageData.VUIP.SpeedUltrafastTip: Tick multiplier for ultrafast. Always available, including without development mode.
LanguageData.VUIP.PlayButtonsTip: Click a button to show or hide it in the bottom-right bar. Dimmed buttons are hidden. Includes the Vanilla UI+ settings button. Extra buttons from other mods appear here after you've seen them in a game.
LanguageData.VUIP.ClearSnoozesNeedGame: Load a save to clear snoozes.
LanguageData.VUIP.SnoozeTip: Right-click to snooze this kind of alert for {0} days.
LanguageData.VUIP.BleedingOutDesc: These people will die from blood loss if they keep bleeding:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.VUIP.HostilesPresentDesc: These hostiles are on a map with your people:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowTraderPresentAlertTip: Alert while a trade caravan or orbital trade ship is still available. Vanilla only sends a letter on arrival, which scrolls away while the trader is left waiting. Click to jump to a caravan trader.
LanguageData.VUIP.TraderPresentDesc: These traders are here now and will leave in time:\n\n{0}
